title: Nuh
tagline: He called his people for 950 years and never gave up; then came the Ark, two by two.
depictionNotes: Prophet Nuh (peace be upon him), his son and the believers are shown, all with dark skin, every woman's hair covered. The statues are shown as plain worn stones with no faces. No picture shows anyone in the flood water. Pictures are AI-generated.
coverAlt: Nuh stands with his hand on the side of the great wooden Ark at sunset, with smiling believers around him.
